[Newmark](https://www.nmrk.com/) announces the Company has arranged the investment sale of[The Bowie](https://www.apartments.com/the-bowie-sandy-springs-ga/18zqqq4/?msockid=1812e5cd0223650b371ef43003be6452) , a 350-unit multifamily community located at 8800 Dunwoody Place in Sandy Springs, Georgia.


Newmark Senior Managing Directors Brooks Colquitt and James Wilber, Vice Chairmen David Gutting and Derrick Bloom and Senior Managing Director Hunter Amos represented the seller in the transaction.


Built in 1980, The Bowie is a 25-building garden-style apartment community situated on approximately 29.5 acres in the highly desirable North Sandy Springs submarket. The property was approximately 86% occupied at the time of sale and has benefited from roughly $8 million in capital improvements since 2018. These upgrades position the asset for continued value creation, providing the new owner with the opportunity to further renovate units and implement operational enhancements.


“The Bowie represented a unique opportunity to acquire a well-located asset in one of Metro Atlanta’s most established and supply-constrained suburban submarkets,” said Colquitt. “Investors were attracted to the property’s premier location, significant value-add potential and proximity to some of the region’s most influential employment drivers.”


Located along the GA-400 corridor, The Bowie benefits from immediate access to one of the Southeast’s most important office and employment hubs. The community is positioned near Perimeter Center and the North Fulton office market, home to a diverse concentration of Fortune 500 companies, major healthcare systems and professional services firms. Within a short drive of the property are more than 300,000 jobs and one of the nation’s largest concentrations of medical office and healthcare employment.


The property’s appeal was further enhanced by its location within affluent Sandy Springs, a market known for strong renter demographics, highly rated schools and limited multifamily development opportunities. Residents benefit from convenient access to Chattahoochee River recreation amenities, Downtown Roswell and Atlanta’s broader transportation network.


The transaction underscores continued capital interest in high-quality multifamily assets throughout Metro Atlanta, particularly those located in affluent submarkets with strong barriers to entry and clear pathways to future income growth.
